description: This Dart source file defines the AppTheme class for configuring themes in a Flutter application with Material 3 design, including light and dark themes, custom styles for components, and a controller for theme mode management.

classes.name: AppTheme
classes.description: A class providing static methods to generate ThemeData for light and dark themes, customized with specific color schemes, component themes, and styles.

classes.name: AppThemeController
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier class managing the current ThemeMode, allowing runtime theme switching and persisting the preference using SharedPreferences.

methods.name: _base
methods.description: A private static method that builds a base ThemeData with a given color scheme, customizing various theme components.

methods.name: lightTheme
methods.description: A public static getter returning the ThemeData configured for light mode.

methods.name: darkTheme
methods.description: A public static getter returning the ThemeData configured for dark mode.

methods.name: setThemeMode
methods.description: Sets the current theme mode and notifies listeners.

methods.name: loadInitialThemeMode
methods.description: Asynchronously loads the initial theme mode from SharedPreferences, defaulting to system.
